projectDescription: A Spring Boot microservices platform built with Spring Cloud, featuring product, order, and inventory services behind an API Gateway with Eureka service discovery and Keycloak OAuth2 security.
keyFeatures: Eureka-based service discovery for dynamic microservice registration
Spring Cloud Gateway with load-balanced routing to all services
Keycloak OAuth2 / JWT authentication enforced at the gateway level
Resilience4j circuit breaker and retry on the Order Service
Polyglot persistence: MongoDB for productos, MySQL for orders and inventario
Maven multi-module project structure for all services
publicApiSurface: POST /api/order — place a new order (with circuit breaker)
GET /api/inventario?codigoSku=... — check stock availability by SKU list
SecurityConfig — OAuth2 JWT resource server filter chain
